decision: ignored the old advice to prefer small fast models
why: official speed score is a step at 5 minutes on a T4, so extra speed earns nothing
evidence: data/package/.../evaluation_metric.md

decision: put near-duplicate photos in the same fold with a loose match threshold
why: a false match costs little but a missed one leaks a photo across train and validation
evidence: scripts/make_folds.py, configs/folds.csv
result: 921 images in groups, 93 mixed real and fake groups

decision: use ImageNet weights only and never fit on test images
why: rules allow pre-trained ImageNet models and ban any training use of test images
evidence: docs/PLAN.md

decision: kept the 18 corruption types added during training
why: worst-case AUC rose while plain AUC stayed level on fold 0
evidence: runs/convnext_tiny vs runs/convnext_tiny_corrupt

decision: dropped self-blended pseudo-fakes
why: blend-only training reached 0.59 on real fakes and mixing lowered AUC on fold 0
evidence: runs/cx_blendonly, runs/cx_blend30, runs/cx_blend50

decision: raised dropout and drop path to 0.3
why: AUC stayed near its peak to the last epoch instead of falling to 0.90
evidence: runs/cx_dp30 last 0.9138 vs runs/convnext_tiny_corrupt last 0.9000

decision: checked inference_script.py on Python 3.10 and across two GPUs
why: a run that fails to reproduce predictions costs 5 points
evidence: runs/probe_a.csv, runs/probe_b.csv, runs/probe_local.csv
result: byte-identical on repeat, max difference 0.00032 across GPUs

decision: kept flip85 plus mixup as the training recipe
why: all four alternatives lost on 5 paired folds
evidence: compare.py --base dflipmix: dsam -0.0002, dgce -0.0036, dsoft -0.0020, dr2 -0.0014
result: SAM, GCE, soft labels and second-round relabelling rejected

decision: reran batch 7b with one job at a time
why: 12 of 16 runs died of GPU memory with two in parallel beside another job
evidence: runs/a_*/stdout.log CUDA out of memory, runs/jobs_e7b_retry.log

decision: measured label errors directly instead of from model disagreement
why: we asked whether the 8 percent claim is proven and it was only model-based
evidence: scripts/exact_copies.py: 145 exact copies, 14 opposite labels, implied flip rate 5.1 percent, about 3 to 8.5 percent at 95 percent
result: README line 46 says annotation ambiguity is intentional; 8 percent lowered to a 3 to 8.5 percent range; clean-label AUC estimate lowered from 0.98-0.99 to 0.96-0.99

decision: first version of the copy test rejected
why: 64x64 correlation cannot tell a copy from a swap because swaps keep pose, so its 9.5 percent was unreliable
evidence: runs/audit/label_conflicts.jpg showed false matches and possible swaps
result: replaced by full-resolution texture test in scripts/exact_copies.py

decision: corrected the clean-label AUC range in the previous row to 0.94-0.99
why: recomputed from measured 0.9147 at flip rates 3, 5 and 8 percent gives 0.941, 0.961 and 0.994
evidence: formula: measured = (1-e)^2 A + e^2 (1-A) + e(1-e)
result: 5 percent central estimate 0.96; applies only if test labels are clean

decision: promoted ResNet-50D to all 5 folds and dropped the other seven trial backbones
why: adding it gave the largest ensemble gain on 2 folds and it is convolution only, which should export to TensorFlow
evidence: runs/oof_e7b.txt: cfm+dflipmix+a_rn50 z 0.9218, next pair additions lower or noise

decision: rejected flip test-time augmentation
why: doubles inference time for no gain on 5 folds
evidence: scripts/ens_eval.py --clean_only: cfm+dflipmix+sfm 0.9144 without flip, 0.9141 with flip
result: off; ens_eval members also reproduce recorded OOF AUC to 4 places

decision: corrected the speed estimate
why: the 49 s laptop run was not forward-pass time
evidence: runs/speed.py forward pass on RTX 3050 Laptop: ConvNeXt-T 531, DeiT3-S 808, ResNet-50D 656, Swin-T 376 images/s; server A6000: 2623, 4322, 3160, 1855
result: 15 members now look affordable, full run still to be timed

decision: backfilled: treated the training labels as noisy
why: bimodal scores, equal suspect rates in both classes, and same-photo pairs with opposite labels
evidence: fold 0: 51 reals above 0.9, 44 fakes below 0.1; OOF suspects 7.4 percent real, 7.2 percent fake at 0.85
result: flip85 relabel list built from out-of-fold predictions only

decision: backfilled: adopted flip85 plus mixup 0.4
why: best paired gain, confirmed on 5 folds
evidence: dflipmix vs deit +0.0052 up on all 5 folds, robust +0.0057; cfm vs cxd +0.0044; flip85 alone +0.0035, mixup alone +0.0015, drop85 +0.0033, flip70 +0.0035; mixup 0.2 and 1.0 lower

decision: final families cfm, dflipmix, a_rn50 unless the CNN screen beats them
why: 5-fold OOF: a_rn50 0.9129, cfm 0.9128, dflipmix 0.9120, three together z 0.9158, adding Swin lowers to 0.9155
evidence: scripts/oof.py on 7000 images

decision: exported only the ResNet-50D family to TensorFlow
why: onnx2tf breaks on ConvNeXt layer-norm transposes and on DeiT; the ResNet graph converts and matches
evidence: a_rn50_f0: max difference 3.87e-07 on 16 images; cfm_f0 error groups=96 input has 56 channels
result: bonus claim limited to one family of three

decision: rejected all four extra ResNet-style backbones
why: none lifted the ensemble on 2 folds
evidence: runs/oof_e9.txt: base 0.9218; with SE-ResNeXt50 0.9217, ECA-ResNet50T 0.9215, BiT-R50 0.9215, ResNet-101D 0.9208

decision: first nested check was invalid and is being rerun
why: folds.csv has CRLF ends so awk removed no rows; nest runs repeated cxd and deit exactly
evidence: cmp: nest_cx_f1 val_preds byte-identical to cxd_f1; folds_nest0.csv had 7001 lines
result: script fixed with a line-count check; side result: same seed and data on one GPU gives byte-identical retraining

decision: rejected learned ensemble weights and stacking
why: all lost leave-one-fold-out on noisy labels
evidence: scripts/stack_test.py: plain 0.9158, weights 0.9151, boosting 0.9128, boosting with image features 0.9110

decision: found weak image groups and tested repair before scoring
why: undamaged AUC 0.9231 but blue-tinted 0.8800, very dark 0.8867, noisy 0.9012
evidence: scripts/canon_test.py: invert blue group pooled +0.0005, stretch all +0.0002, others none
result: repairs barely help; blue group is colour-shifted, a damage type training never simulated

decision: added hue, tint, channel swap and sharpen as an opt-in damage group
why: the weakest group shows colour shifts that the 18 damage types lack
evidence: dfd/augment.py COLOUR, default path checked identical
result: queued as c_col on 3 folds for all three families

decision: queued every untried idea with no effect on the existing recipe
why: we wanted all remaining methods however small the gain
evidence: configs/jobs_e11a-d.txt: highpass, YCbCr, face crop and FFT views; catavgmax pooling; DenseNet, ResNet-26D, ResNet-18, Hiera MAE, InceptionNeXt, FocalNet, ResNet-50 A1, MambaOut, DINO ViT; layer decay, no norm decay, mixup off, weight decay, EMA decay
result: running; regress_f2 checks new code reproduces a_rn50_f2 byte for byte

decision: independent bug audit by a second reviewer; fixed what held up
why: a crash on the judges machine would cost far more than any AUC gain
evidence: empty.jpg crashed inference with cv2.error; after the fix it scores 0.5 with a warning; 0.0 confidence difference across a full run
result: fixed empty-file crash, missing runs/audit folder in three scripts, report step count, SAM with accumulation now asserts; rejected the ResNet-50D parameter finding because 23.53 M is parameters and the count included buffers

decision: load images in the main process and write LF line ends
why: worker processes can die in containers with little shared memory, decoding is a tiny share of the run, sample_submission.csv uses LF
evidence: full run on the laptop GPU: 92.3 s inside the script, 103 s wall clock, confidences identical to 4 workers

decision: a second seed scored lower than the chosen runs on the same folds
why: dflipmix and a_rn50 had been picked from many runs, so their AUC is partly luck; seeds are interchangeable before selection
evidence: s1d 0.9102 vs 0.9120, s1r 0.9098 vs 0.9129; four one-seed-per-family mixes average 0.9149, all seeds together 0.9152
result: report to warn that single-seed numbers run about 0.002 high; adding seeds decided after the screen

decision: flip gain is real but smaller than measured
why: the flip list was built by models that saw every fold; the nested check removes the outer fold from everything
evidence: fold 0: non-nested +0.0092, nested +0.0050, robust +0.0060; one fold only
result: flips stay because they do not touch test labels; headline AUC runs high; queued leak-free runs of all three families on all folds

decision: more data helps, so test retraining on all images
why: 8 paired folds
evidence: scripts/learning_curve.py: 60 to 80 percent of data +0.0043, up on 6 of 8
result: scripts/bag_test.py will compare subset models with seeds on the full training set on 2 outer folds

decision: deleted my own checkpoints of rejected runs on the server
why: disk at 96 percent with about 116 more runs queued
evidence: 80 best.pt files removed, predictions and metrics kept, 7 GB freed

decision: Reject colour damage, new views, Grad-CAM pooling, and training tweaks
why: None beat its base on paired folds
evidence: c_col -0.0014 to -0.0015 on 3 folds; views -0.0038 to -0.0091; t_* -0.0001 to -0.0029; see runs/jobs_e11.log

decision: Train FocalNet-T on the last 3 folds and retry Hiera and MambaOut at parallel 1
why: n_focal +0.0007 AUC, +0.0033 robust on 2 folds; Hiera ran out of GPU memory beside other jobs
evidence: add_one +0.0001 as an extra family; configs/jobs_e13.txt

decision: Rejected zoom, shift and larger-input test-time views
why: No view beat the plain ensemble on 5 folds
evidence: scripts/tta_test.py: base 0.9158; with zoom95 0.9156, zoom90 0.9154, zoom85 0.9154, shift 0.9154, up256 0.9156, up288 0.9150

decision: Leak-free ensemble score is 0.9119, and flips help less than first measured
why: Nested runs removed each outer fold from everything
evidence: compare.py: nd +0.0009 vs dflipmix +0.0052, ncx +0.0019 vs cfm +0.0044; oof.py ncx+nd+nr z 0.9119 prob 0.9118
result: flips stay; report headline changes to 0.9119

decision: Move final models to all 7000 images with several seeds
why: Seeds on more data beat subset models on both outer folds
evidence: bag_test.py: 8 models 0.9174 vs 0.9160 and 0.9121 vs 0.9099; mixing both kinds was lower; learning curve +0.0037 over 40 pairs

decision: Fix one stop epoch per family for all-data runs; corrected the data-gain test
why: bag_test and learning_curve let 80 percent models pick their epoch on the scored fold, so they were biased
evidence: fair_lc: gain at a pooled fixed epoch +0.0033, 35 of 40 up, se 0.0004; per-fold best runs 0.0001 to 0.0009 above the fixed epoch; cfm 19, dflipmix 21, a_rn50 25

decision: Keep the training settings unchanged
why: 28 settings runs tested drop path, dropout, learning rate and mixup on two folds
evidence: compare.py: ResNet and DeiT settings lost on average, best r_do1 -0.0009 and q_do3 -0.0018; x and m runs still finishing

decision: Reject FocalNet and Hiera; test MambaOut on three more folds
why: FocalNet added nothing over 5 folds; Hiera scored far lower; MambaOut was the only positive result on two folds
evidence: compare.py n_focal -0.0001, n_hiera -0.1552, n_mamba +0.0005 robust +0.0031; add_one n_mamba +0.0009 on 2800 images

decision: build_bundle reads statistics for all-data runs from family fold runs
why: An all-data run trained on its validation fold, so its own statistics would be overconfident
evidence: server test on cfm_f0: 7000 pooled images, logit mean 0.133, std 3.341, threshold 0.465

decision: Keep the training settings unchanged for all three families
why: All 17 settings finished on two folds and none beat the current recipe on average
evidence: compare.py: closest x_dp2 -0.0006, x_lr3 -0.0008, r_do1 -0.0009; m_r -0.0031, m_d -0.0022, m_c -0.0015; REGRESS2_IDENTICAL

decision: Export the full ensemble to TensorFlow with a hand-written port
why: onnx2tf failed on two families, which limited the +1 bonus claim
evidence: export_tf_ensemble.py on 15 members and 16 images: confidence difference 1.59e-05, member score difference at most 4.00e-04

decision: Reject MambaOut
why: Adding it needs 5 more members, 33% more run time, and a new TensorFlow port
evidence: 5 folds: AUC -0.0006 against ResNet-50D (per fold +0.0008 +0.0002 -0.0068 -0.0031 +0.0061), robust +0.0008; added to the ensemble +0.0002 on 7000 images, correlation 0.978

decision: Final bundle is the 15 all-data models
why: All training finished without a failure
evidence: threshold 0.455; rank correlation 0.992 with the fold bundle; repeat run byte-identical; fresh install 0.00004; laptop against server 0.00008; TensorFlow 0.00002; laptop 90 and 119 s

decision: independent audit by a second reviewer; fixed what held up
why: inference wrote the CSV before its checks and crashed on a missing output folder; README commands failed after a Windows zip
evidence: two claims rejected after checking: 7.7 percent matches label_evidence.py, 0.0002 matches the final bundle; predictions unchanged byte for byte

decision: Doubling seeds per family adds little, so test new signal types instead
why: seeds only lower random error and members already agree
evidence: scripts/seedcurve.py: both seeds minus mean of one seed +0.0004, se 0.0001, up on 5 of 5 folds; seed correlation 0.977 to 0.989
result: queued e17 small-patch model, soft AUC loss, bootstrapped targets; embed_test nearest images and quality offsets

decision: Reject nearest-image voting, quality offsets, small-patch model, soft AUC loss and bootstrapped targets
why: none beat its base on the same folds
evidence: embed_test.log: kNN best +0.0000, quality offsets -0.0012; compare.py 2 folds: e_aucc -0.0013, e_bootc -0.0010, e_aucd -0.0016, e_bootd -0.0028, e_aucr -0.0046, e_bootr -0.0035, e_p2 -0.0291, e_p3 -0.0041; add_one all negative

decision: Reject six more ImageNet backbones, including NFNet-L0
why: None lifts the 3-family ensemble beyond noise. A 4th family would add about 33 percent run time and another TensorFlow export
evidence: add_one.py on 2 folds: nfnet_l0 +0.0008, res2net50d +0.0002, hrnet_w18 -0.0002, convformer_s18 -0.0002, deit3_base -0.0009; dla34 failed (no drop_path_rate). NFNet on 5 folds, 7000 images: +0.0003, bootstrap se 0.0004, P(gain<=0) 0.25; swapped in for ResNet-50 -0.0006

decision: Rebuilt the TensorFlow export with padding before each depthwise convolution
why: The first export crashed on load in TensorFlow 2.21 on a CPU, which could cost the +1 export bonus
evidence: TF 2.21 grappler remapper fuses explicit-padding DepthwiseConv2dNative with the bias add and fails a tensor_format check; pad then VALID gives a max difference of 0.0 on a test tensor; rebuilt export: confidence difference 2.00e-05 on 16 images, tf_inference.py on 32 test images 0.000084, no label change

decision: Keep the recipe after testing 21 more kinds of damage
why: Colour shifts, rotation, crops, harsher JPEG and resizing had never been measured
evidence: ens_eval.py --extra on 7000 out-of-fold images: mean 0.9104 vs clean 0.9158; 20 of 21 within 0.0072; downscale_0.125 0.8656; heavier damage and colour damage recipes had cost clean AUC (c_col -0.0014 to -0.0015)
result: no retrain; report section 6 and Figure 7

decision: Measured the submission on a real T4 and put the numbers in the report
why: Speed is 20 points and had only been estimated from other GPUs
evidence: Google Colab Tesla T4, fresh pip install -r requirements.txt (torch 2.7.1+cu126, timm 1.0.30, OpenCV 4.14): 72.5 s and 71.4 s whole command, 66.9 s and 66.0 s inside the script; predictions.csv reproduced, largest difference 0.000128, no label change; TF 2.21 on the T4 GPU, 64 images, 0.000085
result: bundle unchanged; report sections 6, 7, 8 and 9 updated

decision: Screen heavy shrinking (augment.lowres, scale 0.10 to 0.35 log-uniform) at p 0.1 and 0.25 on folds 0 and 1
why: The one weak damage type was the 1/8 shrink (0.866); training never shrank below 0.25
evidence: jobs_e20: against the picked runs clean -0.0021 and -0.0027 (se 0.0011), shrink 1/8 +0.0081 and +0.0126
result: looked like a loss; checked against fresh seeds next

decision: Compare against the unpicked second-seed runs (s1c, s1d, s1r) instead of the picked ones
why: The picked runs carry selection luck, so the first comparison was biased against any new run
evidence: folds 0 and 1: fresh 0.9186, picked 0.9218, p0.1 0.9197, p0.25 0.9190; prediction correlation with the picked runs is the same for fresh and lowres runs (0.975 to 0.990), so lowres runs inherit no luck
result: trained folds 2 to 4 for both settings (jobs_e21)

decision: Adopt heavy shrinking at p 0.25 for the final models
why: Ties p 0.1 on clean AUC, fixes the 1/8 shrink more, keeps the same pooled stop epochs
evidence: 5 folds, 7000 images vs fresh run: clean +0.0007 (se 0.0007) for both, mean of 20 damages +0.0005 (p0.25) and +0.0008 (p0.1), worst of 20 0.9056 vs 0.9035, shrink 1/8 0.8786 vs 0.8625, above fresh on 30 of 41 damages; p0.25 minus p0.1 clean 0.0000 se 0.0006; pooled best epochs 19 21 25; 6-model fresh plus p0.25 also 0.9144
result: jobs_e22 all-data runs lowc, lowd, lowr; final_build.sh and reproduce.sh switched

decision: Report confidence stability across image quality
why: The organisers rubric names stable confidence distributions across quality levels
evidence: p0.25 fold version: median shift of mean confidence over 41 damages 0.003, largest crop_80 -0.048, 1/8 shrink shift 0.040 to 0.009; pooled AUC over 42 sets 0.9109 vs mean per-set 0.9110

decision: Rebuilt the submission with the heavy-shrink models and checked it end to end
why: New weights must reproduce exactly, or the script loses 5 points
evidence: final_build.sh: 15 members, cut-off 0.475 (best F1 0.886 on 7000 out-of-fold images); server rerun byte-identical; laptop RTX 3050 twice byte-identical, vs server max confidence difference 0.000085, no label change; fresh Python 3.10 env from requirements.txt 25.8 s, 0.000046, no label change; TF export 16 images 1.13e-05 (members 3.5e-04), TF 2.21 CPU on 32 test images 0.000098, no label change; fold vs all-data test ranks 0.991; old vs new submission ranks 0.994, 21 labels differ; run from inside runs/pkg byte-identical to the laptop run
result: runs/pkg refreshed; previous package kept as runs/pkg_e15; T4 kit rebuilt

decision: Timed the final build on a Colab T4 and put the numbers in the report
why: The report's T4 time came from the build before heavy shrinking
evidence: Tesla T4, torch 2.7.1+cu126, opencv 4.14.0: 73.1 s and 74.9 s whole command (67.0 s and 69.7 s inside the script); 3000 rows, same ids, max confidence difference 0.000113, no label change; TF 2.21 GPU on 64 test images 0.000098, no label change
